description: Phase 2.4 relevance-evaluation dataset (roadmap section 20 Testing Strategy: "curate ~100-300 (query, expected-symbol) pairs from CodePulse's own repository as a starting relevance dataset; track Recall@10, MRR as a regression gate on ranking changes"). Every (query, expected_file_path, expected_symbol_name) triple references a real symbol that genuinely exists in codepulse/ as of this dataset's curation -- verified programmatically against the actual parsed symbol table before being included, not invented.
expected_file_path_convention: relative to the codepulse/ package directory, e.g. "auth.py", "search/bm25.py"

pair_sources.docstring: query derived deterministically from the symbol's own real docstring (first usable sentence)
pair_sources.hand_curated: query hand-written as a natural paraphrase, deliberately NOT reusing the docstring's own wording, to test genuine retrieval rather than docstring-text overlap
